svg.text: Drawn from the local repo plus 10 Bottleneck Codex threads. Latest local boards read: 2026-06-26. Excalidraw MCP was not exposed, so this is a native .excalidraw scene.
Decision discipline, operating loop, SA mirroring, long-only mandate.
Sleeve thesis library and bottleneck upside framework.
Ticker thesis, anti-thesis, hedge/sizing, invalidation, confidence, evidence quality.
Market, filings, and manual channels aggregate into state/latest_events.jsonl. Mock is fallback only.
Classifies events into dip, thesis damage, filings, catalysts, hedge risk, SA exit/reduction, noise.
Run locks + run ledger. Dirty tree is OK unless same-file writes conflict.
validate, strict-live, live-readiness, resume-check before automation resume.
- BUY_NOW requires thesis, valuation, sizing, anti-thesis, hedge, invalidation
- ADD_ON_DIP requires bounded cause, approved protocol, improved valuation, no thesis damage
- SELL requires named broken thesis or unacceptable risk
Bounded-cause prerequisite: market/crowding, company event, financing, thesis damage, unknown.
Full SA exit -> RESEARCH_REQUIRED. Material reduction -> thesis-weight review. Adjacent proxies are not current holdings.

Dashboard buckets: BUY_NOW, ADD_ON_DIP, HOLD, TRIM, SELL, RESEARCH_REQUIRED.
Actions, operational source gaps, dip-cause reviews, active high-priority signals.

Thread-derived context: TSM was earlier chosen as starter BUY_NOW, but current operational decision files show 35 RESEARCH_REQUIRED / 5 HOLD because active signals must be reviewed first.
Current signal pressure: 110 active signal events, including source gaps and 104 dip triggers. Resolve reviewed items with bcap signal resolve; do not hand-edit old rows.
Validation discipline: use bcap validate after process/universe changes; use strict-live or resume-check before unpausing market-day automation.
Worktree note: repo was already dirty. This diagram intentionally avoids touching existing research/state changes.
